Create Your Own Signature Candle – A Relaxing and Memorable Experience
This isn’t just a class—it’s a hands-on experience perfect for date nights, girls’ trips, birthdays, or a unique self-care outing. Whether you’re a total beginner or a DIY lover, we handle the math and science so you can relax, have fun, and create with confidence.

Choose or blend your own custom fragrance from over 40 scents and create a signature blend that’s uniquely yours.

You’ll pour your candle into a practical and useful keepsake glass and also create a matching 2 oz room spray to enjoy right away. It’s the perfect souvenir—something you’ll actually use and remember.

This experience is a great break from the beach, a perfect rainy-day activity, or a fun addition to your trip.

Come for the creativity, stay for the vibe—and leave with something truly special.
